describe: The image shows a seamless patch of mottled ground, like moss or lichen, covered by bright saturated yellow and lime-green areas mixed with darker olive and orange-brown patches. Blotchy clusters of varied size with fine speckled detail are spread evenly across the square. Colours are vivid yellow, lime green, olive and rusty brown, with high brightness and strong contrast. Lighting is flat and the texture is fine and granular.
